inputs.name: Finite global ray class and Hilbert class field theory
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Class Field Theory
inputs.accepted_statement: A finite abelian extension is a ray-class quotient for a modulus supported on its ramified places. The modulus-one ray class field is the ordinary Hilbert class field, with real places remaining real. The rational ray class field for l^r times infinity is Q(mu_(l^r)).
inputs.exact_specialization: CZ2: finite image of an original G_Q -> M[l] homomorphism yields a finite abelian extension inside the same Omega; unramified outside l implies containment in a finite cyclotomic layer. CZ3: original G_K -> M[l], K constructed inside Omega, unramified at all finite places; the real-place order-two image vanishes because l is odd, so its image is a quotient of the ordinary class group.

inputs.name: Elementary number-field and local-field background
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Algebraic Number Theory
inputs.theorem_reference: Sections 2–3 and 6–7; Proposition 6.2 gives the finite cyclotomic ramification facts also derived in CZ2.
inputs.accepted_statement: Integral basis/discriminant index formulas, unique ideal factorization and finite Galois inertia, Eisenstein total ramification and Hensel lifting to finite unramified extensions.
inputs.exact_specialization: CZ2 derives the full finite cyclotomic inertia images and uses compact nested fibers for an actual infinite-level lift at each original valuation. CZ3 derives the Gauss identity, discriminant l, two-dimensional convex-body representative bound, ideal count, and h_K<l explicitly.
